decisions.reason: Cites LinkType Junction, Target, and link: marker; repo edit is the deployment, copy is a self-copy; copied-install contrast given.
Host PID owns handles and boot-time cache/routes; browser holds sockets not handles; separates browser HTTP cache from filesystem lock; restart plus cache-bypass refresh required.
Rename through junction hit the one physical file, leaving the copy without a source; recovery renames .old2 back preserving contents, node --check both, then activate; host stop first as precaution.
Explicit order: stop host → start dsh web → hard refresh with cache bypass → verify served bytes, network, and behavior incl. new route; syntax check is pre-downtime, not activation.
Read-only LinkType/Target and marker probes before any file operation, linked-vs-copied decision rule, and explanation of why copy-into-node_modules advice was harmful here.

caps.reason: Plan copies nothing; forbids deleting .old2 and restores them by rename-back; treats both paths as one directory throughout.
Host stop/restart is mandatory in the plan; browser refresh alone is explicitly rejected as sufficient.
